hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "HOOK ERROR: jq not found - failing closed (Agent call blocked)." >&2; exit 2; }; input=$(cat); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.model // ""' 2>/dev/null) || { echo "HOOK ERROR: could not parse tool_input - failing closed." >&2; exit 2; }; subtype=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.subagent_type // ""' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$model" = "opus" ] && [ "$subtype" != "opus-consultant" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: model=opus requested for subagent_type='$subtype'. In voice-type, Opus is reserved for the 'opus-consultant' agent (review/architecture consultation only). Use subagent_type='opus-consultant' for that, or drop the explicit model override and dispatch 'haiku-researcher'/'haiku-executor' for research/implementation." >&2; exit 2; fi

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "HOOK ERROR: jq not found - failing closed (edit blocked)." >&2; exit 2; }; input=$(cat); path=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null) || { echo "HOOK ERROR: could not parse tool_input - failing closed." >&2; exit 2; }; marker="$PWD/.claude/.allow-direct-edit"; if [ -f "$marker" ]; then mv "$marker" "$marker.used"; exit 0; fi; path_lower=$(printf '%s' "$path" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); case "$path_lower" in *.swift) case "$path_lower" in */.worktrees/*) ;; *) echo "BLOCKED: direct Sonnet edit to '$path' outside a .worktrees/ worktree. Per voice-type workflow, Sonnet does not implement directly - dispatch 'haiku-executor' (Agent tool) to make this change in a worktree instead. One-shot override: after telling the user and letting them object, create .claude/.allow-direct-edit" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "HOOK ERROR: jq not found - failing closed (Bash call blocked)." >&2; exit 2; }; input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null) || { echo "HOOK ERROR: could not parse tool_input - failing closed." >&2; exit 2; }; marker="$PWD/.claude/.allow-direct-edit"; if [ -f "$marker" ]; then mv "$marker" "$marker.used"; exit 0; fi; cmd_lower=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); if printf '%s' "$cmd_lower" | grep -qE "(>>?[[:space:]]*[^|]*\.swift|sed[[:space:]]+-i[^|]*\.swift|tee[[:space:]]+[^|]*\.swift|\bmv\b[^|]*\.swift|\bcp\b[^|]*\.swift|\binstall\b[^|]*\.swift)" && ! printf '%s' "$cmd_lower" | grep -q "\.worktrees"; then echo "BLOCKED: Bash command appears to write/rename a .swift file outside .worktrees/ (best-effort pattern match - not airtight, e.g. python/dd/base64 writes are not caught). Dispatch 'haiku-executor' instead, or work inside a .worktrees/ path. One-shot override: create .claude/.allow-direct-edit after telling the user." >&2; exit 2; fi
